- **Pico CSS** v2.0.6 — [picocss.com](https://picocss.com) — MIT License
\n- **model-viewer** v4.3.1 — [modelviewer.dev](https://modelviewer.dev) (`@google/model-viewer`) — Apache-2.0 License; bundles three.js (MIT). Loaded only when a 3D object is opened in the Gallery.\n
